## Checklist

- [ ] `gofmt -l .` reports nothing
- [ ] `go vet ./...` and `go test ./... -race` pass
- [ ] Tests added/updated for the change
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` `[Unreleased]` updated (if user-visible)
- [ ] `README.md` updated (if a label, setting, or documented behavior changed)
